copy.heroIntroduction: Pharmacy First offers support for common conditions to people in Wombwell. Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield.
localContextParagraphs: Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is in Darfield, which, like Wombwell, is a ward in Barnsley's South Area Council.
